Detailed classification within Record_Type. Public Bodies terms follow the standard UK public-body taxonomy, with three project-specific additions: "Independent Regulator" for economic and sectoral regulators; "Statutory corporation" for bodies corporate and corporations sole that are not departments, agencies or NDPBs and are not servants or agents of the Crown; and "Non-governmental body / Partnership" for non-public organisations held on this sheet. "Government Unit / Authority" covers joint cross-government units (e.g. NISTA, [ORG-023]). Note that the Public Bodies sheet holds a small number of non-public organisations; the sheet name understates its scope and is retained because the dashboard build scripts key on it.
Controlled_Vocabulary: Public Bodies: Ministerial Department | Non-Ministerial Department | Executive Agency | Executive NDPB | Advisory NDPB | Independent Regulator | Statutory corporation | Devolved Administration | Devolved Public Body | Government Unit / Authority | Local Government (collective) | Non-governmental body / Partnership; Legislation: Primary Legislation | Secondary Legislation | Bill (pre-legislative) | Retained EU Law

DERIVED SHEET - do not edit by hand. One row per record, copied from the sheet the record lives on (Record_ID, Name, Acronym where the source sheet has one, Record_Type, General_Type, Policy_Sector, Extent where applicable) plus the source sheet name. Regenerated in source order by Data/code/rebuild_xref.py, which finalise.py runs as step 1 of 4 before the integrity check, so any manual edit is overwritten at the next run. Nothing reads this sheet: it is a human convenience index, which is why it drifted unnoticed between the 2026 vocabulary migration and v25.
